source_item.title: Global bond rally eases as sticky PCE locks in December Fed hike

card.plain_headline: Global bond rally cools as inflation data supports Fed rate hike
card.what_happened: A recent rally in global bonds has eased as inflation data came in higher than expected, reinforcing the likelihood of a December interest rate hike by the US Federal Reserve.
card.what_happened_verbose: The recent positive momentum in the global bond market, where prices typically rise as yields fall, has stalled. This slowdown is attributed to the latest Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index data, a key inflation gauge closely watched by the Federal Reserve. The 'sticky' or persistent inflation indicated by the data strengthens the case for the Fed to continue its monetary tightening by raising interest rates at its upcoming December meeting, which typically pressures bond prices downward.
